# Resets: RIS (ESC c) and DECSTR (CSI ! p).

=== RIS clears the screen, homes the cursor and resets the pen and modes
source: esctest2 ris.py test_RIS_ClearsScreen, test_RIS_CursorToOrigin, test_RIS_ResetDECOM
input: abc\e[2;4r\e[?6h\e[4h\e[1m\e[3;3HX\ecY
cursor: 1,2
style: 1,1 default
screen:
|Y.........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|

=== RIS resets the tab stops
source: esctest2 ris.py test_RIS_ResetTabs
input: \e[3g\ec\t
cursor: 1,9

=== RIS leaves the alternate screen
source: esctest2 ris.py test_RIS_ExitAltScreen
input: \e[?1049h\ec\e[?1049$p
replies: \e[?1049;2$y

=== RIS removes the margins
source: esctest2 ris.py test_RIS_RemoveMargins
input: \e[2;3r\ec\e[9B
cursor: 5,1

=== RIS keeps the scrollback
source: xterm (RIS clears the screen, not the saved lines)
scrollback: 5
input: a\r\nb\r\nc\r\nd\r\ne\r\nf\ec
history: 1

=== DECSTR leaves the cursor where it is
source: esctest2 decstr.py test_DECSTR_CursorStaysPut
input: \e[3;4H\e[!p
cursor: 3,4

=== DECSTR turns IRM off
source: esctest2 decstr.py test_DECSTR_IRM
input: \e[4h\e[!pa\e[1;1Hb
screen:
|b.........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|

=== DECSTR keeps DECAWM
source: esctest2 decstr.py test_DECSTR_DECAWM
input: \e[!p\e[1;9Hxxx
cursor: 2,2

=== DECSTR removes the top and bottom margins
source: esctest2 decstr.py test_DECSTR_STBM
input: \e[2;3r\e[!p\e[1;1H\e[9B
cursor: 5,1

=== DECSTR turns DECOM off
source: esctest2 decstr.py test_DECSTR_DECOM
input: \e[2;3r\e[?6h\e[!p\e[1;1H
cursor: 1,1

=== DECSTR forgets the saved cursor
source: esctest2 save_restore_cursor.py test_SaveRestoreCursor_Reset; decstr.py test_DECSTR_DECSC
input: a\e7\e[!pb\e8c
cursor: 1,2
screen:
|cb........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|

=== DECSTR resets the pen
source: xterm ctlseqs DECSTR (SGR to normal)
input: \e[1;31m\e[!pA
style: 1,1 default

=== DECSTR turns DECLRMM off
source: esctest2 decstr.py test_DECSTR_DECLRMM, decset.py test_DECSET_DECLRMM_ModeResetByDECSTR
input: \e[?69h\e[!p\e[?69$p
replies: \e[?69;2$y
